propositions: Six src/rebar files (_inbound_differ.py, apply_inbound_records.py, det_floor.py, executor.py, prompts.py, init.py) sit at 786-800 LOC within or above the locked 800-LOC module-size cap with zero headroom for new code additions.
Any edit including comment additions to files at 799-800 LOC causes CI module-size-gate hard-fail with no allowlist escape; this blocks contributors and creates merge queue latency.

Files must be split along existing logical/architectural call-graph seams with each resulting file 100-500 LOC, never raising the locked limit, leaving real headroom, and preserving all existing test behavior unmodified.
_config_sources.py (791 LOC) is now uncovered by any RP epic or open ticket after its claimed owner closed, and is newly in scope as a near-cap file requiring extraction.

Commits must be measured against current origin/main census (prior measurements stale after 45 recent upstream changes); each child ticket must name its concern boundary split and verify imports via both Serena find_referencing_symbols and grep.

Acceptance requires all six target files under 720-LOC headroom band with real clearance, all complexity ratchet gates passing with new=0, and .github/module-size-limit.txt byte-identical to pre-epic content.
